element_id.description: Qualified id from the page data, e.g. s2.e4
element_id.title: Element Id

observation.description: What the element is/does, from the page data only
observation.title: Observation

confirmed.description: Set by the tester, never by the model
confirmed.title: Confirmed

element_id.description: Element or region id (not for url_*)
element_id.title: Element Id

evidence.description: Which requirement, what was observed, or why it is assumed
evidence.title: Evidence

Health.description: Liveness information for the API process.
Health.title: Health

Insight.description: The model's answer (validated; ids checked against what was sent).

assumptions.description: Business-rule assumptions not shown on the page
assumptions.title: Assumptions

Insight.title: Insight

InsightOut.description: A grounded model answer with the usage evidence of the call that produced it.

browser_ms.description: Inspection (browser) time of the scoped pages
browser_ms.title: Browser Ms

InsightOut.title: InsightOut

duration_ms.description: Browser time in the runner (not model time)
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

InspectionScope.description: CSS selectors of containers to include (empty = whole page) or exclude.
InspectionScope.title: InspectionScope

LocatorSpec.description: One locator. ``value`` is the role / label / test id / placeholder / text / CSS.
LocatorSpec.title: LocatorSpec

basis.description: observed = follows from page data; assumption = relies on a business rule
basis.title: Basis

element_ids.description: Elements the action uses (ids from the data)
element_ids.title: Element Ids

blockers.description: Why G1 is not possible yet (empty = approvable)
blockers.title: Blockers

element_labels.description: Display label per element id, e.g. button "Save"
element_labels.title: Element Labels

element_id.description: Interactive element id; not for goto
element_id.title: Element Id

value.description: Text to fill, option to select, key, or goto URL
value.title: Value

url.description: Any URL of the target site; its origin becomes the allowlist
url.title: Url

approval_id.description: G5 approval of exactly that version
approval_id.title: Approval Id

SetupStep.description: One tester-approved step run before inspecting (e.g. signing in). Data, not code.
SetupStep.title: SetupStep

post.description: Restore = new version with old content. Needs a G5 approval of exactly that version.
A tester edit: always a new version (author ``user``); approvals stay on the old one.

get.description: Serve a stored artifact file (screenshot, page HTML). Confined to ``artifacts/``.
Report that the API process is up.

post.description: Ask the runner to open the page (visible browser), inspect it and store a snapshot.

put.description: Steps run before inspecting this page (e.g. sign in), ADR-018. URLs must be on-origin.

post.description: Record a human approval bound to an exact version (G0-G2, G5) or a subject (G3, G4).

get.description: Live updates (inspection started/finished, approvals, …) as Server-Sent Events.
The most recent successful insight call, or ``null``.

post.description: Summarise the approved scope and suggest next actions, grounded in the snapshots.

get.description: Every model call attempt for the project, newest first (usage evidence).

put.description: A tester edit: validated against the approved scope, stored as a new version.

post.description: Ask the model for a plan grounded in the approved scope (or revise it with feedback).

get.description: The latest scope, or ``null`` if none was saved yet (not an error).

put.description: Store the tester's selection, exclusions and goal as a new scope version.
